note: Every piece is now above 60 and silhouette reached 70; mean delta +4.8. The round's most valuable output was not a pixel but a discovery: geometry.js encodes appendages by pushing uv.y above 1.0 and documents that species.js reads that mask — and species.js line 1110 does `uv().y.clamp(0.0, 1.0)`, destroying the signal before anything can use it. Three rounds of crowns, calyxes and stem wells have been shading as plain body skin. A documented cross-file contract that was never implemented on the receiving side, invisible to both owners because each file is correct in isolation. Probe integrity was audited and HELD: the frozen clip probe reproduces its v1 baseline exactly (mask_px 9490, 5.227%) after six version bumps by different agents. Perf regressed as five builders each added structure and only one owned the budget: draw calls 88 -> 123 against a bar of 120, worst-case JS frame 3.4 -> 7.3 ms.
